_doc: Contract for the zero-spend media corpus (T2). corpus.test.ts ffprobes every file and asserts it matches these properties. Regenerate bytes with generate.sh; update this file if you intentionally change a clip.

clips.role: landscape bars — default video success asset
short motion clip, off-spec dims (forces normalize scale/pad)
multi-second clip WITH audio — exercises audio mix / mute / volume
portrait 9:16 motion — PiP overlay source / aspect handling
portrait still — раскадровка frame / image consumer
